```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/slice-modules.ps1", "tools/check-lossless.ps1", "modules/00-header.ms", "modules/01-structs.ms", "modules/02-chunkreader.ms", "modules/03-materials.ms", "modules/04-import-core.ms", "modules/05-ui-renegade.ms", "modules/06-preferences.ms", "modules/07-mix.ms", "modules/08-ui-main.ms"], "verifyCommand": "pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/check-lossless.ps1", "acceptanceCriteria": ["9 byte-exact slices", "concat(00..08) SHA == legacy lines 1-6485", "line counts sum to 6485"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Write build-w3dimporter.ps1 (concatenate modules)
tasks.description:
build-w3dimporter.ps1: banner line + raw concat modules/*.ms (00..08 then 99) → root w3dimporter.ms, no separators; pwsh only.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["build-w3dimporter.ps1", "w3dimporter.ms"], "verifyCommand": "pwsh -NoProfile -File build-w3dimporter.ps1", "acceptanceCriteria": ["exact banner + CRLF", "body == concat(00..08)+99 no extra bytes", "no Max needed", "order 00..08,99"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Regression guard — lossless + deterministic build
tasks.description:
USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE. tools/check-build.ps1: (a) concat(00..08)==legacy lines 1-6485 (baseline), (b) built==banner+concat(00..08)+99 (rebuilt determinism); negative control flips a byte → FAIL → revert.

```json:metadata
{"userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "requiresUserSpecification": false, "requireEvidenceTokens": [["baseline", "legacyBody"], ["rebuilt", "built"]], "files": ["tools/check-build.ps1"], "verifyCommand": "pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/check-build.ps1", "acceptanceCriteria": ["concat(00..08) == legacy lines 1-6485", "built == banner+concat(00..08)+99", "guard fails on injected drift then reverts", "check-legacy-frozen still passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Package the .mzp drag-drop installer
tasks.description:
packaging/mzp.run (name/version/description/copy w3dimporter.ms to $userScripts/drop w3dimporter.ms — NOT run) + packaging/pack-mzp.ps1 (build→guard→stage→Compress-Archive→rename .mzp→verify root entries) → dist/w3dimporter.mzp.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packaging/mzp.run", "packaging/pack-mzp.ps1", "dist/w3dimporter.mzp"], "verifyCommand": "pwsh -NoProfile -File packaging/pack-mzp.ps1", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mzp.run uses copy-to + drop (not run)", "mzp root = mzp.run + w3dimporter.ms", "pack rebuilds+guards first"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

Capture menu screenshot + import log + node-name diff.
